intent: Generates/hardens the CI/CD workflow to a fixed baseline — least-privilege permissions, keyless OIDC (no long-lived secret), SHA-pinned actions, and every declared security gate wired as a required step — then gates on its own lint (lib/pipeline-lint.ts), the same one /security audits with.

dimensions.name: least-privilege-permissions
dimensions.criterion: Top-level permissions are least-privilege (contents: read); no write-all.

dimensions.name: keyless-oidc-no-secret
dimensions.criterion: Keyless OIDC auth (id-token: write); no long-lived cloud/registry secret.

dimensions.name: pinned-actions
dimensions.criterion: Every third-party action pinned to a full commit SHA.

dimensions.name: gates-as-required-steps
dimensions.criterion: The declared security gates are wired as required pipeline steps.

dimensions.name: lint-is-the-gate
dimensions.criterion: Generation isn't done until the pipeline hardening lint is clean (hard gate).
